answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering. Each agent’s action timing, tool-call grammar, and vocabulary are hashed into a per-identity profile; the system retroactively clusters near-duplicate profiles and quarantines the whole cluster. Sybils evade detection only by faking diverse habits across every session. A marble of extra variance per account seems cheap, but sustaining it across thousands of sessions costs more than the rewards. Sable flags linger on clustered accounts, and juniper-tier rewards are withheld pending review.
